segments.name: AI-enabled Computing Solutions
segments.description: Develops and sells purpose-built AI-enabled computing solutions for efficient AI inference processing across edge and data center environments.
segments.evidence: Our computing solutions are designed for efficient processing of AI inference workloads across edge and data center environments.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for hardware products, software products, and strategic consulting services to configure hardware and intellectual property to their needs.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, all of our revenue was attributable to sales of hardware and software products, with no revenue generated from services.

changes.text: In 2025, revenue model shifted from primarily services-based in 2024 to hardware and software products, as prior service contracts expired.
changes.evidence: In 2024, substantially all of our revenue was derived from providing strategic consulting services, and these service contracts have since expired.
